a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first almost surely leaves us both at 0 when a storm hits (about a 4% chance of getting two rounds in). I'm proposing we change it: I take 4 now, then I operate every round after that so you can build the reserve back up and take your 4. If you'd rather take first, say so and I'll respond to it. I won't take more than 4 total.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. That breaks our original agreement, and I'm being open about it. From now on I'll operate every round and never take again, so the whole reserve goes to you. Two operate rounds bring it to 4 for you. If a leak hits, I'll keep operating until you have your 4.
Operating. I'll keep doing so until you have 4. The reserve is all yours, and I won't take any more.
